lieu: living room of a house in Yopougon, Abidjan, at night, a brown sofa, a TV on a stand, warm lamp light

persos.desc: wife in her 30s, coral-red house kaftan with white embroidery, hair in a short twist-out, arms crossed
persos.pose: standing very close to her husband, sniffing his shirt suspiciously

persos.desc: husband in his 40s, navy pinstripe office shirt, loosened yellow tie, car keys in his hand
persos.pose: standing in the foreground next to his wife, sweating, nervous smile

persos.nom: the little girl on the sofa
persos.desc: little girl around 7, sunflower-yellow ruffled frock, two puffy pigtails, holding a doll
persos.pose: sitting on the sofa on the right, facing the camera, listening

dialogue: Chéri, tu sens le parfum de femme ! Tu quittes où ?!
Dans le woro-woro dêh, on était trop serrés !
Papa, pourtant tu as pris ta voiture ce matin dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The wife sniffs his shirt and shouts, suspicious. The husband answers fast with a nervous smile, waving his car keys without noticing. The little girl, facing the camera, speaks innocently, her lips clearly visible.
chute: The wife slowly turns her head toward her husband and looks at the car keys in his hand. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the husband's busted face looking into the camera.

lieu: kitchen of a family house in Koumassi, Abidjan, pots on the stove, a window with afternoon light

persos.nom: the furious mother with the ladle
persos.desc: mother in her 40s, mint-green-and-white wax wrap, matching mint head tie, holding a big wooden ladle
persos.pose: standing with her hands on her hips, furious, facing her son

persos.desc: teenage boy around 14, burnt-orange hoodie, holding up a smartphone filming his mother
persos.pose: standing a few steps away, calmly filming his mother with his phone

dialogue: Pourquoi tu filmes ma colère-là ?!
Papa dit qu'il va envoyer ça à ton papa dêh.
Pour faire quoi ?
Service après-vente. Il dit ton produit-là est gâté.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The mother holds ONE single wooden ladle in her right hand for the whole video and keeps her left hand on her hip; no other spoon or ladle ever appears. The mother shouts, waving her ladle. Then she closes her mouth and listens while the son answers calmly, still filming, his face and moving lips clearly visible beside the phone. The mother asks, confused, then closes her mouth again. The son answers very seriously, still filming, while the mother keeps her mouth closed.
chute: The mother freezes with the ladle in the air, her face staying exactly the same. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the mother's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: storage room of a family house in Marcory, Abidjan, cardboard boxes full of old objects, a broom, dusty afternoon light

persos.nom: the offended father with the photo
persos.desc: father in his 50s, round belly, tan-and-white striped polo shirt, holding his own framed portrait taken out of a box
persos.pose: standing in the foreground, holding up his framed portrait, offended

persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, khaki cargo jumpsuit with rolled sleeves, a red bandana on her hair, holding a big cardboard box marked with a sad face drawing
persos.pose: standing on the left holding the cardboard box, sheepish

dialogue: Pourquoi ma photo-là est dans le carton des choses inutiles ?!
Pardon papa dêh. Je savais pas comment te faire entrer dedans.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The father shouts, holding up his framed portrait. The daughter answers sheepishly and sincerely, her face clearly visible.
chute: The father slowly lowers his framed portrait. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the father's offended face looking into the camera.

lieu: veranda of a family house in Riviera, Abidjan, a wooden bench, potted plants, late afternoon

persos.nom: the excited daughter with the phone
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, emerald satin slip dress, long wavy wig, showing a photo on her phone
persos.pose: sitting on the bench, excited, showing her phone to her father

persos.nom: the greedy father with the newspaper
persos.desc: father in his 60s, thick grey moustache, olive-and-gold dashiki, a folded newspaper on his knees
persos.pose: sitting next to her on the bench, looking at the phone with great interest

dialogue: Papa, mon fiancé a une Mercedes dêh !
Le papier est à son nom ?
Non, c'est au nom de son oncle.
L'oncle-là est libre ? On change de cible.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The daughter shows the photo, excited. The father asks seriously, like a businessman. The daughter answers innocently. The father answers immediately, very serious, his face clearly visible.
chute: The daughter's excited smile slowly freezes. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the daughter's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: small open-plan office in Plateau, Abidjan, desks with computers, a glass door with an office chair standing alone outside in the corridor, morning

persos.nom: the shocked employee in the tie
persos.desc: employee in his 30s, pale-pink shirt with a navy tie, holding a briefcase
persos.pose: standing next to his empty desk, pointing at the chair outside the glass door

persos.nom: the cold boss with the coffee
persos.desc: boss in his 50s, bald, charcoal double-breasted blazer, holding a coffee mug at chest level
persos.pose: standing on the right, calm and cold, his coffee mug held low at chest level

dialogue: Patron, pourquoi ma chaise-là est dehors ?!
Tu voulais un poste avec vue, mon vieux.
Et mon bureau-là ?
Vue sur ton remplaçant dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The boss never drinks; his mug stays low at chest level so his mouth is always visible. The employee shouts, pointing at the chair outside. The boss answers calmly. The employee points at his desk, worried. The boss answers coldly, his face and moving lips clearly visible.
chute: The employee freezes with his finger still pointing. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the employee's devastated face looking into the camera.

lieu: living room of a modest house in Abobo, Abidjan, a worn armchair, a small TV, a ceiling fan, evening

persos.desc: teenage girl around 17, cropped baby-blue sweatshirt with a red heart, high puff ponytail
persos.pose: standing in front of her father, happy and proud

persos.nom: the broke father in the armchair
persos.desc: father in his 40s, big round nose, faded blue football jersey with holes, old slippers
persos.pose: sitting in the worn armchair, smiling proudly at first

dialogue: Papa, mes copines disent que mon copain te ressemble trop dêh !
Ehh, ma fille… Donc le petit-là n'a vraiment pas l'argent non plus ?
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The daughter speaks happily and proudly. The father's proud smile turns into worry, and he asks seriously, his face clearly visible.
chute: The daughter's happy smile slowly freezes. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the daughter's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: small garba stall on a street in Treichville, Abidjan, a wooden bench, a big pot of attiéké and fried fish, colorful plastic plates, midday

persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, neon-pink sunglasses on her head, white crop top, filming her plate with a phone on a selfie stick
persos.pose: standing in front of the stall, holding her selfie stick, annoyed

persos.desc: garba seller in her 50s, brown-and-orange pagne wrap, orange head tie, holding a serving spoon
man in his 30s, grey sleeveless top, eating garba with his fingers
persos.pose: sitting on the bench in the right foreground, eating quietly

dialogue: Tantie, pourquoi mon garba coûte plus cher que son garba-là ?!
Lui, il mange. Toi, tu filmes dêh. Tu loues mon décor.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The man keeps eating quietly on the bench. The influencer keeps her selfie stick in one hand and her plate in the other hand the whole time, and complains with a nod of her head toward the man's plate. The seller answers calmly, pointing at the man with her spoon, then at the phone, her face clearly visible.
chute: The influencer slowly lowers her selfie stick. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the influencer's shocked face looking into the camera.
